note: On Whitewater Lake in the Southern Kettle Moraine; the sandy beach, boat launch and camp store are at the lake road by the entrance, and the nightly sites are up the hill away from the water (the Prairie loop, the pull-throughs and the tree-line sites). Mostly seasonal: about 60 of its roughly 200 sites are sold by the night. --Claude

flags: PRICE (private): $50.00 + tax for a W&E RV site (page last modified 2024-03-27) - exactly at the US$50 line, not over it; 'Concert Weekends - rates are slightly higher' (no figure). No Good Sam Park, no gateway within 40 km (Milwaukee 72 km). Google 4.4 (315); RV Life 4* $$. Presence passes (working website, phone 608-883-2920, ResNexus Book Now). Rate is dated only by the page edit (March 2024); the ResNexus engine could not be read to confirm a 2026/2027 figure.

LONG-STAY (mostly seasonal, kept on the tests): the 2026 map shows ~58 nightly RV sites (P1-P41 in The Prairie, pull-throughs C1-C11, T1-T6 'Back in tree line') plus 2 nightly tent sites (SR15, SR16) against roughly 140 seasonal sites - about 30% nightly (map count, approximate). Test 1/2: nightly rate posted ($50); test 3: nightly reservations by engine, phone or form; test 4: well over 1 in 10 nightly; test 5: no lots sold (seasonal sites leased by the season, waiting list). Nothing discourages nightly guests. Note now says 'Mostly seasonal: about 60 of its roughly 200 sites are sold by the night'.
MIN STAY: reservations need 2 nights at all times ('Reservations are not accepted for a 1 night stay'), 3 on holiday weekends; a single night is walk-up only. Not a 3+ standing minimum.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The nightly sites are up the hill east/south-east of the lake road, well away from Whitewater Lake behind wooded seasonal loops; only the beach, launch and store are at the water.

PIN 42.7557,-88.6958 is at the entrance/camp store by the beach on the lake road. The seasonal loops run south-east from there (~42.7533,-88.6945, ~300 m) and the nightly Prairie loop lies further east up the hill; the imagery available predates the Prairie loop shown on the 2026 map, so its pads can't be placed exactly. Reviewer may leave the pin at the registration office or move it to ~42.7540,-88.6935.
